rationale: This is a one-operator substitution inside the archive's already-tested best signal (Cash-Insured Innovation Value), and because cash-to-assets is highly persistent the five-year minimum will be nearly collinear with the current level, so the "funding security vs. funding level" distinction it claims to test is unlikely to be identifiable.

R&D intensity is one of the most persistent firm characteristics, so TS_MIN(xrd/at,5) is effectively a proxy for the R&D-intensity level already used in several archive signals (and mostly just separates R&D from non-R&D firms via the zero floor), making this a near-rediscovery of value × R&D intensity rather than a new economic statistic.

The one-sided worst-case revenue-growth conditioner is internally consistent with the stated sign and is a genuine diagnostic repair of the failed two-sided volatility version, though it overlaps meaningfully with fundamental-volatility/distress screens and worst-case revenue contraction may proxy for realized bad news rather than absent customer capital.

The minimum-of-ranks aggregation is a substantively different (conjunctive rather than compensatory) combination rule with a falsifiable economic claim and clear interpretation either way, and the expression's direction is consistent with the positive expected sign, despite the mild kitchen-sink risk of stacking three previously tested conditioners.

Netting cash and purchased intangibles out of assets leaves what is essentially tangible asset turnover, so this reduces to the well-known value × asset-turnover (DuPont/quality) composite rather than a new inference about off-balance-sheet capital, and the revt denominator is fragile for low-revenue firms even after winsorization.

The expression is malformed (trailing comma in `ADD(ib, COALESCE(xrd, 0), )`), and the core idea — a multi-year average earnings numerator over current price — is the long-documented cyclically-adjusted/normalized earnings-yield anomaly bolted onto the archive's existing best conditioner, so both the construction and the novelty are weak.
